meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证程序缺陷并修复,自动以 PR 或 issue 形式提交到正确仓库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你修好了某个工具的 Bug,却不确定该提 PR 还是开 issue。
copy.tagline_en: Verify and fix a defect, then submit it as the right pull request or issue
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you fixed a bug but aren't sure whether to open a PR or an issue.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会调试具体的 LazyCodex 或 Codex 缺陷：在临时工作区复现、先写回归测试、做最小修复，再交付——LazyCodex 的问题提成内嵌补丁的 issue，上游 Codex CLI 的问题提成 fork PR。
howto.when: 当你要求修复或贡献某个 bug 的修复，或调试 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷并向上游提 PR 时触发。

say.text: 帮我修一下 LazyCodex 这个 bug
say.note: 会生成内嵌补丁的验证修复 issue

say.text: 调试这个 Codex CLI bug 并向上游提 PR
say.note: 会 fork openai/codex 并创建 PR

say.text: 复现这个缺陷，给我最小修复
say.note: 在临时工作区复现并加回归测试

howto.what_en: Claude debugs a concrete LazyCodex or Codex defect in a temp workspace, writes a regression test, applies the smallest fix, and delivers it: a patch-embedded verified-fix issue for LazyCodex, or a fork PR for upstream Codex CLI.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to fix or contribute a bug fix, or to debug a LazyCodex/Codex defect and open a PR upstream.

say_en.text: Fix this LazyCodex bug for me
say_en.note: Produces a verified-fix issue with the patch embedded.

say_en.text: Debug this Codex CLI bug and open an upstream PR
say_en.note: Forks openai/codex and creates the PR.

say_en.text: Reproduce this defect and give me the smallest fix
say_en.note: Reproduces in a temp workspace, adds a regression test.
